The execution failed because the generated summary lacked the mandatory 'Decision:' keyword, despite correctly identifying the recommendation.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in `test_summary_contains_key_outputs` because the string 'Decision:' was missing from the summary file. While the model successfully calculated revenues and provided a recommendation (`keep_90_day`), the test specifically requires the exact label 'Decision:'. Avoid omitting required headers; ensure the summary strictly follows the 4-8 line format including all mandatory keys.
